reason: LocalLens is a macOS-only OCR plugin that extracts text from screenshots, clipboard images, and image files using Apple's local Vision framework, then returns the text to the agent context.

summaries.zh: LocalLens 使用 macOS 内置 Vision OCR 从屏幕截图、剪贴板图片和图像文件中提取文字并返回给智能体。
summaries.en: LocalLens uses macOS's built-in Vision OCR to extract text from screenshots, clipboard images, and image files for use by the agent.

capabilities: Captures the main macOS display when requested
Reads clipboard images and user-specified image files
Processes images locally with Apple's Vision OCR
Returns recognized text to the model context
Compiles and executes a local Swift OCR helper
